## TO DO: make method 



```{r}

plot_single_feature_EIC <- function(eic_data, i, j_vec) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  
  # extract chromatograms for feature i across selected samples
  df_list <- map(j_vec, function(j) {
    chr <- eic_data[i, j]
    data.frame(
      rt = chr@rtime,
      intensity = chr@intensity,
      sample = paste0("Sample_", j)
    )
  })
  
  df <- bind_rows(df_list) %>%
    filter(!is.na(intensity))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = rt, y = intensity, color = sample)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = paste("EIC for Feature", i, "across samples", paste(j_vec, collapse = ",")),
      x = "Retention Time (s)",
      y = "Intensity",
      color = "Sample"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

```
